Name: Michaiah, Daughter of Uriel
Summary: Michaiah, daughter of Uriel of Gibeah, was the mother of Abijah, king of Judah.
KeyStory: Abijah reigned three years in Jerusalem, and his mother's name was Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah.
RelatedPeople: Abijah, King of Judah; Uriel, of Gibeah
LifeLesson: Mothers of kings are named because their sons' reigns are part of God's record.
